messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “Juego de head soccer” in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a Spanish-language 1v1 head soccer game as a standalone HTML canvas game, with keyboard and touch controls, CPU opponent, goals, timer, pause, restart, and sound.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a responsive game interface and canvas gameplay to `index.html`.
- Confirmed embedded JavaScript syntax with Node.
- Opened the game at `http://localhost:3002` in Playwright and resized the browser to 1280×900.

### Active
- Finish browser gameplay and visual checks; save and inspect a JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- No known blockers.

## Next Move
1. Capture the page in a `.jpg` screenshot and inspect it.
2. Test starting, keyboard/touch controls, pause/restart, and match scoring in the browser; fix any issues.
3. Summarize the finished game and assumptions for the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game UI, styles, and embedded game logic.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local Python HTTP server is running on port 3002.
- Playwright initially reported a missing Chromium browser; Chromium was installed, and the page then opened successfully.
- The only browser console error reported was a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).
